A Role Taxonomy for S LM Components
Selected literature model documentation standards and technical systems
Detect the language script speech channel or visual input type before interpretation Validate by language code switching pattern noise condition and device environment
Convert audio into text while preserving speaker timing names numbers and uncertainty Evaluate on the actual acoustic and domain conditions rather than generic word error rate alone
Map a linguistic reference to an element in a screen image or document Grounding accuracy must be separated from the success of the later action
Select the organizational or knowledge domain that owns a request Hard data governance rules should filter permissible destinations before learned routing
Map a request to a supported operation or explicit unknown state Test paraphrases compound intents prohibitions conditions and out of scope cases
Connect names and descriptions to versioned internal objects The result should preserve candidates and evidence when identity is ambiguous
Identify temporal quantitative policy and exclusion constraints Validate by source span and by mutation of negation units and scope
Recognize when several interpretations remain plausible The preferred output is a typed clarification need not a confident guess
Change language while preserving meaning terminology modality names quantities and structure Domain specific invariants are more important than general fluency
Map variants to a controlled vocabulary without erasing legitimate distinctions Every normalization should be reversible or linked to the source form
Identify sections clauses claims tables code and references Deterministic layout and parser evidence can complement compact models
Populate a typed schema from text or images Evaluate field correctness omissions source alignment and abstention
Represent claims qualifiers evidence and uncertainty rather than merely selecting salient sentences Scientific and legal claims require domain profiles
Select and realize a shorter representation under explicit coverage and contradiction preservation rules Store source linked structure as the authoritative artifact where possible
Remove or transform sensitive information under a named privacy objective Local execution helps but re identification and retention require separate controls
Change register tone or reading level without strengthening claims Compare the transformed text against protected semantic invariants
Reduce a large catalogue to a policy permitted candidate set Measure recall of the correct tool confusion among similar tools and behavior on irrelevant requests
Choose one or more tools for the current state Validate at the level of completed policy compliant state transitions not isolated syntax
Map entities and constraints into a tool schema Type checking is necessary but semantic identity and units must be verified separately
Generate a coarse decomposition and identify dependencies or unknowns Stable subplans should be delegated to workflows or symbolic planners
Search action sequences under explicit preconditions and effects The planner guarantees only what the domain and state representation express
Translate intent into approved query objects or parameterized procedures Direct unrestricted writes should remain outside model authority
Map language into predicates rules or constraints Evaluate source fidelity independently from solver acceptance
Generate executable transformations where narrower representations are insufficient Require sandboxing tests resource limits and dependency controls
Check a candidate against schemas tests evidence policies or formal constraints Declare exactly which property the verifier establishes
Select candidate information for persistence The model proposes a write policy assigns type provenance sensitivity authority and expiry
Select state or evidence using relevance authority recency dependency and permission Similarity alone is insufficient
Identify incompatible or superseded memories without forcing premature resolution Preserve versions and evidence
Render actual evidence formal artifacts and execution traces for a reader Do not replace missing provenance with a plausible rationale
Package unresolved interpretation evidence and failed checks for a stronger model specialist or human Evaluate both under and over escalation
Detect content or action categories under a named policy The classifier supports but does not replace deterministic permissions and governance
Organize evidence and trade offs for a person with authority Measure calibration and decision quality not user preference alone

A clear example of a tiny specialized action model intended for customized function calling and local deployment It is not positioned as a broad conversational assistant application fine tuning and validation are central
Small general foundations for local adaptation with a wider family that includes structured multimodal and domain variants Gemma terms are not the same as Apache or MIT licensing
Multimodal models designed for efficient edge execution Useful as local perception and language components real device performance depends on modality context and runtime
Current generation Gemma models include compact effective size variants and function calling support Vendor comparisons should be treated as product evidence not independent superiority claims
A compact embedding specialist that illustrates how retrieval and memory can use a dedicated local component rather than a general generator
A translation focused family that supports the argument for separating language transformation from open ended reasoning
A safety classification family It can provide modular policy signals but a classifier is not an access control or authorization mechanism
A medical text and multimodal family for developer applications Domain specialization does not confer clinical authority and must be combined with evidence validation and human governance

Compact Microsoft models emphasizing high quality and synthetic data reasoning and function facing applications Their practical value lies in strong local foundations not in assuming all tasks fit a small context independent model

Open weight compact general and reasoning capable models with broad ecosystem and tool use support The family is a useful base for routers and specialists validation should distinguish thinking modes and deployment settings
Widely supported compact models explicitly positioned for on device use Their ecosystem is a major advantage licence terms and application specific tool behavior require review
Hugging Face compact models with unusually open training information valuable for research on small model data multilinguality reasoning and reproducibility
An influential open small model training effort and useful baseline for studying data and architecture at roughly one billion parameter scale
Research focused on optimizing sub billion architectures for on device tasks It demonstrates that compact regimes benefit from architecture choices rather than simple shrinking
Enterprise oriented dense models emphasizing instruction following tool calling and predictable latency embedded in a broader family of speech vision embeddings and guardian models
IBM Granite adapters and modular libraries
An industry signal toward treating AI capabilities as composable software functions The value depends on compatibility versioning and evaluation of each adapter
Apache 2 0 compact multimodal and multilingual models in base instruct and reasoning variants targeted at local and edge use The 14B size is operationally small only for some deployment regimes
Evidence that reasoning oriented behavior can be transferred into smaller derivatives They are better viewed as compact reasoning workers than automatically safe action policies
Production examples of hardware aware local language and multimodal intelligence with guided generation tool calling and adapters They are proprietary and tightly coupled to the Apple platform
A family spanning on device and private cloud roles with architecture and quantization optimized by deployment target Public evaluation is primarily vendor reported
Efficient and sparse model families oriented toward agentic reasoning and deployment Active parameters total storage and serving stack should all be considered
Specialized API selection and argument generation families across several sizes They show the importance of action data and multi turn evaluation checkpoint licences and exact use conditions vary
Compact function calling models designed for on device robustness including mechanisms such as function masking and irrelevant function training
Data and refinement methods for function calling especially relevant to improving small models through model aware synthetic examples
A landmark tool use system combining API data retrieval and search It is more important as an architectural and data precedent than as a current production recommendation
An early API connected model line that helped establish tool retrieval and grounded API generation as distinct research problems
A research direction in which a small orchestrator coordinates stronger models and tools It supports the idea that compact models can allocate intelligence rather than reproduce it
Open biomedical continued pretraining models Useful as domain foundations but the broad medical label should be decomposed into specific tasks and risks
A pre generative example of domain specialization in legal language It remains conceptually important because many legal tasks are classification and extraction rather than open generation
An open financial model initiative illustrating domain data and adaptation Financial deployment requires temporal data controls policy and evaluation beyond general model quality
Constrain fields types and required structure They establish representational validity not the truth or appropriateness of values
Restrict token generation to a grammar during decoding XGrammar Outlines and llama cpp grammars improve syntax and efficiency but do not establish semantic safety
Restrict language to improve deterministic parsing and review Attempto Controlled English is a mature reference domain coverage and author usability remain trade offs
Separates abstract syntax from multilingual concrete syntax useful for mapping several languages to shared domain representations when grammars are explicitly engineered
Execute data retrieval and updates under database semantics transactions and access controls Prefer approved query objects for consequential operations
Retrieve explicit entities and relations Graph completeness ontology quality and provenance determine the legitimacy of conclusions
Check satisfiability and derive models under logical and theory constraints The solver is exact relative to the encoded formula natural language formalization remains fallible
Support non monotonic rules and combinatorial search Appropriate for policies and discrete decisions when facts and rules can be stated explicitly
Represent classical planning domains and search valid action sequences The guarantee does not cover omitted preconditions uncertain effects or an inaccurate initial state
Perform deductive reasoning over formal theories LINC and related systems use language models as translators and provers as exact reasoners
Combine uncertain neural predicates with explicit logical structure Useful where perception is uncertain but relations are formalizable
Checks program properties without executing every path It can validate generated code for defined classes of defects and should be paired with sandboxing and tests
Provide executable evidence over selected examples and invariants Passing tests does not prove correctness outside the test envelope
Explores program paths under symbolic inputs Valuable for generated procedures and policies with scalability and environment model limitations
Verifies temporal or state properties over a formal system It is useful for bounded agent protocols when the transition model is explicit
Solve scheduling allocation and configuration problems exactly or approximately under declared objectives The objective function remains a human and organizational choice
Enforce organizational decisions deterministically Progent illustrates a policy language around tool calls generated policies still require validation
Own state transitions retries timeouts and compensation They are often a better substrate than asking a model to remember procedural state in text
Restrict filesystem network process and dependency effects of generated code or tools They reduce blast radius rather than prove code harmless
Bind results to identities versions and content hashes They establish integrity and origin not correctness of the content
Provides contextual judgement and authority that no formal component can assume Its effectiveness depends on evidence presentation and reviewer calibration
Role in an S LM stack
Local CPU GPU and accelerator inference with broad quantization support and grammar constrained generation
High throughput shared serving continuous batching and efficient attention memory management for open models
Cross platform inference and hardware provider abstraction for deploying compact models and classifiers
PyTorch oriented deployment runtime for mobile and embedded devices
Google edge runtime for local inference on mobile and embedded targets
Apple silicon framework useful for local model adaptation and inference
Efficient grammar guided structured generation that can serve as an output control layer
Structured generation library spanning local and hosted model backends
Graph and state machine orchestration with checkpoints and human intervention patterns
Framework for composing tool using and multi agent applications complexity should be justified by real heterogeneity
Compact agent library aligned with open models and tool based execution
Typed model outputs dependency injection and durable execution integrations for contract oriented agents
Document retrieval and workflow infrastructure for knowledge intensive agents
Role in an S LM stack
Role oriented multi agent orchestration Its value depends on whether roles correspond to distinct capabilities and evidence
Agent development and orchestration within Google s model and tool ecosystem
Tool handoff tracing and guardrail abstractions for hosted model agent systems
SMT solver backend for constraints policy checks configuration and software reasoning
Answer set programming backend for rule driven and combinatorial decisions
Classical planner for explicit PDDL domains
Persistent memory provenance transactions and access control The database should own durable state rather than a prompt transcript
Capture model tool state policy latency and cost events Tracing becomes evidence only when identities and artifacts are versioned
Evidence required and principal falsification condition
Minimum sufficient generality predicts model choice

A role characterization procedure should select portfolios with equal or better governed task success and lower total cost than size first baselines across several domains Failure to generalize beyond one workflow weakens the claim
Recurring trajectories should yield stable data contracts and validators whose amortized value exceeds maintenance Rapid drift or persistent semantic diversity would falsify broad applicability
Compact action models can own routine tool use
They must complete multi step policy compliant state transitions with reliable abstention and recovery High isolated function accuracy with poor end to end reliability is disconfirming
Models should preserve source meaning more often after training on compiler solver and counterexample feedback Merely increasing parser acceptance without semantic fidelity is failure
External symbolic computation reduces required neural capacity
Hybrid systems should match or exceed larger monolithic models on formalizable tasks at lower cost while exposing guarantees If translation errors dominate the substitution advantage is limited
Contract first runtimes improve trust and maintainability
With the same base models contract systems should localize failures contain privilege and permit component replacement better than prompt centric baselines
Agent native memory improves long horizon reliability
Provenance versioning conflict and expiry should reduce stale state and contamination failures If complexity adds more errors than it prevents the hypothesis fails
Routing can safely concentrate general model use on novel states
Routers must reduce cost without increasing severe silent failures and should outperform simple rules under distribution shift Persistent oracle gaps constrain the claim
Evidence required and principal falsification condition
Heterogeneous multi agent systems help when warrants differ
Gains should correlate with real parallelism independent tools or verification not fictional roles Equal budget comparisons against simpler workflows are mandatory
Local compact models create strategic privacy value
Deployments should reduce external data exposure while maintaining access control retention and update governance Locality without data governance is not supporting evidence
Specialization can improve fairness and alignment testability
Narrow roles should permit deeper subgroup and policy evaluation New bias from domain data distillation or quantization must be measured improvement is not assumed
Capability packages become durable organizational assets

Versioned contracts data validators and provenance should survive model replacement and improve future development If knowledge remains trapped in prompts and tacit integration the programme has not succeeded
